title: Reused Boarding Pass
description: A boarding pass that's already been torn at the gate shouldn't get a second trip through. Prove a refresh token can't be spent twice.
successCondition: Log in, call POST /api/auth/refresh once with the th_refresh cookie (this succeeds and rotates it), then call POST /api/auth/refresh AGAIN with that same original cookie value. The second call returns 401 with { error: { code: "UNAUTHORIZED" } }. Confirm via `npm run db:psql` that the original refresh_tokens row's revoked_at was already set (by the first, successful rotation) before the second call was even made — the rejection is reading existing state, not a new write.
hints: apps/api/src/modules/auth/service.ts's refresh() rejects any presented token whose stored row already has a non-null revokedAt.
Save the original cookie value in a variable before the first refresh call, since the server will try to replace it with a new one you don't want to accidentally use instead.
